radiusSource: Radius 1.14 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since K2-232 c does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 81,500.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 5.31 Jupiter masses (Ranshaw et al. 2026, the minimum mass (M sin i) the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2026arXiv260909077R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260909077R/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
orbitalPeriodSource: Ranshaw et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260909077R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname RANSHAW_ET_AL_2026): P 1950 d

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of K2-232 c is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

massSource: 5.31 Jupiter masses: Ranshaw et al. 2026, the minimum mass (M sin i) the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2026arXiv260909077R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260909077R/abstract).
